mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.req_no AS reqNo, r.title, r.content, r.project_id AS projectId, r.folder_id AS folderId, p.name AS projectName, f.name AS folderName, r.priority, r.status, r.proposer, r.owner, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM requirement r LEFT JOIN project p ON r.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doc_folder f ON r.folder_id = f.id
mapper.select: WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.folder_id = #{folderId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement (req_no, title, content, project_id, folder_id, priority, status, proposer, owner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reqNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{projectId}, #{folderId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{proposer}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE requirement SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
